content: Mishat, yuwaa Apanll Isusoo Melkisaa tamapari ashiru yaramapaneem ínarangu anoo kamanchintspa

Melkisa sirútamasa mang yakat Sarenshuch urkari taarangiya. Mishat, Apanlleem yaramapantam taarangiya. Sirútamasa zitaminarini Apramarini kurakaa zameetpat mang waratarangu, Apramarini kasiyaru, zoonllee yanpurangiya.

Kanapeeshinusin, naantachu, Melkisaa chamayangarangiya. Melkissha Apramarineetsi: Apanll shiyaa kizpur chinaktanda. Shiyaa urutari istachinlla, mang, tárangiya Apramarineetsi. Táyaru, Apramsha yuwaa yáyashinu anpa kurikee 10 taaru minamari ipuseeru mang panata, maacheetstam 10 taaru minamari ipuseeru panata ashirangiya Melkisaama. Ashiriya, ¿Melkisa tamaamaja? Melkisa sura, iyashuch k'kini, Kizpur apanllpan wamari kasiru, atuni atiniya. Mishat, yakat Sarena sura, iyashuchtam k'kini, Mang' mapiyrsin taakana, atuni atiniya.

Mishat, mang Melkisa wapari ndunarimun, wanirsha ndunarimunatamta. Ashiri ¿chakshuchimasaja tputsi? Yasareezini. Itaru, mang Melkisa nllurtarangeeja, mishat tsiparangeeja. Ashirucha, urutamari Apanlleem yaramapaneem taakiya. Apanll Wip tamapari ashiritam urutamari yaramapaneem taakiya.

¿Tamashta Melkis apanllpaneem kizpur taarang? Mangooz yaramapanee wamari kasirangiya. Apramarinsha pakeeru, anoo natstayaru, Kizpur apanllpani; átu mangush chinayaru, Apanllee urkiri panarangiya Melkisaama. Apaya, Apanlleem wayarangi anoo shiysha yángcha, táyaru panarangiya.

Sirútamasa Móysisarini Leviyarinchich tputs yaramapaneem ipusarangu, Siysa tputs kurikee Apanlleem wayakana anoo yáta yáta shingtsa. Maachi Apanlleem wayakana anoo yáta yáta shingtamtsa, tárangiya. Watam Apanlleem yaramapaneem taaksawa, tárangiya. Iyashuch tputs ichinguruni Apramarinchichtanicha. Minumari anchichinand iy kurasirini. Leviyarinchichi iyaptatam kurasirini washunand taarangitaata, Apanllsha kurikee yamaam kamachtarangiya Leviyarinchicheetsi.

Itaru, Melkissha Leviyarinchicheeja. Nllitarita tputsi. Leviyarini ndatuma nllurtachu, Melkisa uru taarangiya. Itaru, Apramarinsha Melkisaa natstayaru, Kizpur apanllpancha átu, kurikeetstam maacheetstam Apanlleem wintsiri panarangiya. Panayaru, Melkissha yarangiya. Sheeru, Apramarineetsi Apanll tamapari ashiru wanasiri tsiyatarangiya. Apramaa, Apanll shiyaa kizpur chinakiya; tárangiya. Shiyaa kizpur istachiya, tárangiya.

Melkisa Apramarineetsi kizpur kasirangiya. Ksumishpa Apanllee yasarangiya. Anumandsha Apramarinsha anoo natstayaru, Kizpur apanllpani uwa; táyaru, Apanlleem urkir wayakana anoo panarangiya. Mishat, iyashuchsha mang, Melkisa urutamari taakiya; atanaya. Ashirucha, Melkissha urutamari taaku, iyashuch yaramapanirineetsini kasiktamcha, watam iyashuch tsipakanawa. Ashiriya, Melkissha zitaminarinee Apramarini kasirangiya. Mishat, iyashuch yaramapanee kasiktamcha.

Iy uru Leviyarinchicheem kurikee panakaniya. Itaru, Leviy upachiri, Apramarini Melkisaam kurikee panarangiya. Leviy ndatuma nllurtachu, upachirsha Melkisaa chamayangayaru, Kizpur apanllpancha; táyaru, kurikee panarangiya. Leviyarinchichi apanllpantam taakana. Itaru, Melkisa kizpur aranginasha apanllpan taarangiya.

Apanll ichtaru Leviyarinchichee yaramapaneem ipuseeru, Siysa tputsee yutaritshishee yaramaam uru istangtsa, tárangiya. Kamachtarangitaa, tputs itsinsaru taamaam pinasarangana. Leviyarinchichtam izuuru tputsush mang' tachingamaam pinasarangana. Ashirucha, urutari Apanll Wipaa zanganimaam chinarangiya. Melkisaam tamapari ashiru urutamari yaramapaneem taamaam chinarangiya. Ashiriya, Wipsha nish tsapurunasush kuseeru, nda Leviyarinchichush tputs nllurtarangiya, nduni. Nllitaritash tputs nllurtarangiya. Utaásarinchichush nllurtarangiya, watam Apanll mangush nllitarita chinaranguwa.
Nllitaritaa yaramapaneem chinarangiya. Mishat, nllitaritaatstam k'kuz chinarangitamta tputsee tapachindamaama.
¿Antaati iyash Utaásarinchich yaramapan taar? Wanindaja. Mishat, Utaásarinchich Apanllush pang' pshturangazinllinaja. Opeejaa muchirangazinllinaja.
Itaru, Apanll kaneeschee k'kuz chinayaru, Waanaatsi Wip Melkisarini yaramapan tamapari ashiru zanganirangiya urutari yaramapaneem taamaama.
Wipaa zanganeeru, nda Leviyarinchicheem ínarangiya, watam uwsha, Leviyarinchich tputs uru tsipakanawa. Itaru, Melkisa yaramapan matspash taaku an tamapari ashimamtam urutamari taamaam zanganirangiya.
Apanll waana, táranguwa Wipaatsi;

content.text: Shiy Melkisarin tamapari ashirush urutamari apanllpan urkar taachsha,

content: tárangiya.

Ashiriya, na Apanll Wipaa zanganirangu, sirapuch k'kuz na watsta tiya. Leviyarinchicheetstam na yaramapaneem watsta atitamta. Sirapchee k'kuz tputsush mang' izuuru tachingtareeja. Tputs itsinsaru taamaam istatareeja. Xapoorangana.

Ashiri waanaatsi Wip tputsee izuurumamarisha istamamari zanganirangiya. Ashiri iysha Isusumun mangini tatkuni, Apanllsha mangeetsini izuuru yarkiya. Mangini kis Apanllpat ipunkiniya, watam Isus Melkis tamapari ashiritamtawa.

Sirútamasa Apanll Leviyarinchichee tputs ipusarangu, Siysa yaramapaneem urutamari taatssa, tárangeeja, nduni. Itaru, Wipaa zanganeeru, Nuw minamari k'kuz payukina. Tsimbun payukeezi. Shiysha urutamari apanllpan urkar taachsha; Wipaa tárangiya.
Apanll na Isusootsimarisha chinakiya, watam wamarisha kasiruwa. Ashiri anootsimarisha, Isusootsimarisha chinachinipa.
Iyashuch yaramapan urkari tsipakchu, minootssha ipuskana. Minum tsipakchu, minootssha ipusta ashkana. Uru ashishtar ashtaranaya. Ashimapaneem zapan taarangana.
Itaru, Isussha na nda ashkiya; minumarisha anumarisha yaramapaneem na taakiya. Tsipacheeja ndambaree. Ashiri urutamari tapachindampan taachiya. Urutamari istamapaneem taachiya.
Ashiri na tputssha: Apanllee mangoonpi; átu, Isusumun mang' tatku, Isussha tapachindachiya. Urutamari Waparip taamaam tapachindakiya, watam iyaam uru Waparpat tsiyatkuwa.

Isus yutarit taaranginaariya, ¿tamari iyaa istach? Itaru, ksumish wanasirimish taarangu, iyaa istakiya. Yutarit chinarangeeja. ¿Yapshtaja yáyaruch Isusootsi yutarit tsiyatchich? Wanindaja. Uru wanasirimish taarangiya. Iy tputsini ashtareezini. Yutarit iy taakaniya. Itaru, Isus nda ashirangiya. Waparee kuk uru izuuru payurangiya. Nda minumtiyam k'kuz kapeetarangiya. Ashiri Apanllsha Wipaa yusur ituyamayaru, kis waanpeetam yamarangiya.

Itaru, iyashuch yaramapani tputssincha. Yutarittam chinakana. Ashiri ndatumasa tputsee yaramaam istakchu, uru waanaatsi yutaritshishirineetsi yareersin, tputsee istamaam waritarangiya. Opeejaa pachayarusin, yartarana. Ashiri waamatam putam yarta putam yarta ashirangana. Itaru, ashkeeja Isusu. Isus tsiparangu, támeeru, yutaritshishee ichinguru tachingarangiya. Minumta Isus tsiparangu, ichingasha tputsee yutaritshishirinee tachingarangiya.

Apanll sirapuch k'kuz tsiyatarangu, Leviyarinchichee tputs yaramapaneem ísamangandama, tárangiya. Tputstaa waana yutaritshishee ichtaru yarkachu, nuwaam yaramapaneem taamaam waritakcha natumasamta, tárangiya Apanlli sirútamasa. Itaru, natsha kaneesich k'kuz tsiyatku, waana wipaa yaramapaneem ísamarangiya. Nuw minamari k'kuz na chinakina; tsimbun chinakeezi. Shiy ipari, urutamari yaramapaneem taachsha, tárangiya. Ashiri urutamari iyaam yaramapaneem taachiya.
